issues.jp_before: 日本[にほん]料理[りょうり]{で|de-scope}何[なに]{が|ga-stative}一番[いちばん]好[す]きです{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: Fourth copy of the 'Xで何が一番好き/嫌い/得意ですか' frame (with lines 8, 19, 53); not enough variety.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 日本料理で一番作りやすいのは何ですか ('Which Japanese dish is the easiest to make?') and set lv to 4.

issues.jp_before: 夏休[なつやす]み{に|ni-time}友[とも]だち三人[さんにん]{で|de-scope}海[うみ]{に/へ|ni-destination}行[い]きました。
issues.problem: English 'three friends and I' means four people, but 友だち三人で means a group of three.
issues.action: Changed the English to 'three of us friends went to the beach together'.

issues.jp_before: 日曜日[にちようび]{に|ni-time}家族[かぞく]四人[よにん]{で|de-scope}買[か]い物[もの]{に|ni-purpose}出[で]かけます。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the line before it (家族四人で ...).
issues.action: Rewrote it as クラスのみんなで公園を掃除します, with f=2 and a new why.

issues.jp_before: 夕方[ゆうがた]、姉[あね]{と|to-with}二人[ふたり]{で|de-scope}部屋[へや]{を|o-object}掃除[そうじ]しました。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of 姉と二人で京都に行きました (same 姉と二人で frame; 母と二人で is also used).
issues.action: Rewrote it as 週末は友だちと四人でキャンプをしました, with f=2.

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{は|wa-topic}一人[ひとり]{で|de-scope}三十人[さんじゅうにん]{の|no-possessive}学生[がくせい]{を|o-object}教[おし]えています。
issues.problem: English 'by herself' assumes a gender the Japanese does not state.
issues.action: Changed the English to 'teaches thirty students alone'.

issues.jp_before: サンドイッチ{と|to-and}コーヒー{は|wa-topic}全部[ぜんぶ]{で|de-scope}八百円[はっぴゃくえん]です。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of 本とノートは全部で千五百円です. Its distractor の was also borderline in the new frame.
issues.action: Rewrote it as サンドイッチとコーヒーで八百円です with f=1 and changed the distractors to に/を/と.

issues.jp_before: 今週[こんしゅう]{で|de-scope}今日[きょう]{が/は|ga-subject}一番[いちばん]寒[さむ]いです。
issues.problem: 今週で at the start of the sentence reads like 'as of / ending this week'. The sentence was unnatural as a superlative range.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 今日は今週で一番暑い日です with f=1.

issues.jp_before: 音楽[おんがく]{で|de-scope}ジャズ{が|ga-stative}一番[いちばん]好[す]きです。
issues.problem: Bare 音楽で in a statement is awkward. A native speaker would say 音楽の中で or 音楽では.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 音楽の中でジャズが一番好きです with f=1.

issues.jp_before: 一年[いちねん]{で|de-scope}一番[いちばん]忙[いそが]しい{の|no-nominalizer}{は|wa-topic}十二月[じゅうにがつ]です。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of 一年で一番寒い月は二月です.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 一日で一番忙しいのは朝です ('The busiest time of the day is the morning').
